subject: Access custody & SCIM sync evidence request (Cygnus Health)
messages:
From: Elaine Perez <elaine.perez@cygnushealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Cygnus Health Security Team <security@cygnushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SSO/SCIM/RBAC evidence for SIG response

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the earlier SOC/SIG intake call. To complete our vendor questionnaire and internal audit we need a compact bundle of evidence showing how Redwood manages identity and access for our tenant. Specifically we need: 

- SAML assertion samples (including NameID and attributes) for a successful login from Cygnus domain.
- SCIM delta logs for the provisioning window 2026-04-28 to 2026-05-04 (create/update/delete events).
- A role snapshot export showing role definitions and membership as of 2026-05-01.
- A short "least privilege" mapping that ties each role to the minimum scopes it grants (spreadsheet OK).

Any redactions for PII are fine; we just need the fields present and consistent. Can you confirm what you can deliver and an estimated delivery date? We'd prefer the bundle by COB Friday if possible.

Regards,
Elaine Perez
Security Program Manager
Cygnus Health

Attachments: none

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Perez <elaine.perez@cygnushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: SSO/SCIM/RBAC evidence for SIG response

Irene / Naomi — forwarding Cygnus's ask below. They want a compact evidence bundle for SIG/SOC2 review: saml assertions, scim delta window, role snapshot, and least-privilege mapping.

Quick notes:
- Keep assertions anonymized (replace account IDs with redacted tokens) but preserve attribute names and formats.
- SCIM delta should include timestamps, operation type, and affected id; we can redact email addresses but keep internal_id and external_id fields.
- Role snapshot: system export (not hand-compiled) preferred.
- Add a one-paragraph attestation (signed by EPM or IAM owner) stating the export is accurate and unmodified.

Can you triage who will pull each item and an ETA? If Friday is tight, get a partial drop (assertions + role snapshot) first.

-Markus

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: SSO/SCIM/RBAC evidence for SIG response

Thanks — taking point on SCIM and role snapshot. Planned split:

1) Saml assertion samples — Naomi will sanitize and produce XML samples (saml_assertion_samples.xml).
2) SCIM delta export (2026-04-28 to 2026-05-04) — I'll run the delta job, filter by tenant_id=cygnus_health, and output scim_delta_20260428-20260504.csv. Will include op,type,timestamp,internal_id,external_id,raw_changes. PII fields will be replaced with token_<hash>.
3) RBAC export — we'll pull the system role snapshot (rbac_role_snapshot_20260501.json). If Cygnus prefers CSV, we can convert.
4) Least privilege mapping — short workbook (least_privilege_mapping_202605.xlsx) that maps role -> actions -> justification.

Attestation: Naomi, can you draft a single-paragraph attestation we can sign? I can also prep a README.txt describing redaction rules and export commands.

ETA: I can get (1) and (3) by EOD Thursday, SCIM delta by Friday morning, mapping by Friday EOD. If that's okay, we'll send a partial package Thursday.

Irene

--
Irene Choi
Senior Product Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
